critique.evidence: Standard motion is limited to one subtle opacity pulse on an 8px status dot across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Its sampled timing is smooth at roughly 15.3–16.4ms average with 16.7–16.8ms worst frames. Overall tablet/mobile timing is stable with 0 long frames; desktop is weaker at 20.73ms average and 33.4ms worst. Reduced-motion correctly matches and produces no measured element changes, but still reports one active animation. No measured frames prove polished selection, panel-update, or responsive-layout transitions, so an 8 is not supported.
